exceptions.rationale: Reviewed frontend e5322a16ed71c08f0aa07f882e059e3536ff1975: braces 3.0.3 is dev-only through Lingui/micromatch and static-copy/chokidar. Lingui uses static repository patterns with filenames as data through picomatch; static-copy watches literal repository targets, never request paths or filenames as brace patterns. No untrusted brace-pattern input reaches braces; vulnerable executable code is absent from the Nginx runtime (retained SBOM metadata is not code). Before renewal, recheck published fixes, dependency topology, reachability and runtime contents; prefer dependency remediation.
